Card Q&A.q: Do Digimon played from the trash with this card's [When Digivolving] effect also gain  from this card's [Your Turn] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it does. Digimon that gain  from this card's effect keep it after Digivolving, and can attack the turn they come into play.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's effect to play a Digimon from the trash, then digivolve that Digimon during the same turn, does that Digimon gain ?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost.
[Your Turn] When you play a Digimon from your trash, that Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
